txt_en: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
txt_cn: 善良的话语或许很简短，很简单，但产生的回响却是无穷止尽。
author: Mother Teresa

txt_en: What lies behind you and what lies in front of you, pales in comparison to what lies inside of you.
txt_cn: 无论是你的过去，还是将来，与你的内在相比，都微不足道。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

txt_en: Success is the sum of small efforts — repeated day in and day out.
txt_cn: 成功就是日复一日那一点点小小努力的积累。
author: Robert Collier

txt_en: Climb mountains not so the world can see you, but so you can see the world.
txt_cn: 爬上山顶并不是为了让世界看到你，而是为了让你看到整个世界。
author: David McCullough Jr.

txt_en: Don't go through life; grow through life.
txt_cn: 别只是过活，要通过生活获得成长。
author: Eric Butterworth

txt_en: Appreciation is a wonderful thing. It makes what is excellent in others belong to us as well.
txt_cn: 欣赏是一件美妙的事，它让别人的优点也成为我们自己的。
author: 伏尔泰

txt_en: Here's to a vacation of no regrets!
txt_cn: 为无悔的假期干杯！
author: Joan Rylen

txt_en: Magic is believing in yourself; if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
txt_cn: 相信自己是种魔法，能做到这一点，就可以实现任何事。
author: 歌德

txt_en: Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.
txt_cn: 幸福靠的不是运气，而是选择。
author: Jim Rohn

txt_en: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
txt_cn: 即便生活给了你一些不和谐的音符，也别让它们破坏你的人生之歌。
author: Suzy Kassem

txt_en: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
txt_cn: 没有欢笑的一天便最是虚度。
author: E. E. Cummings

txt_en: One man with courage makes a majority.
txt_cn: 若有勇气，一个人抵得上千军万马。
author: Andrew Jackson

txt_en: Life is a pure flame, and we live by an invisible sun within us.
txt_cn: 生命是一束纯净的火焰，我们依靠内心看不见的太阳而存在。
author: Sir Thomas Browne

txt_en: Life is a beautiful magnificent thing, even to a jellyfish.
txt_cn: 生命美好而壮丽，就算对一只水母来说也是。
author: Charlie Chaplin

txt_en: The cure to boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
txt_cn: 无聊的解药是好奇心，但好奇心没有解药。
author: Dorothy Parker

txt_en: The bravest sight in the world is to see a great man struggling against adversity.
txt_cn: 世界上最勇敢的景象，便是勇者无畏地与逆境搏斗。
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

txt_en: You must take life the way it comes at you and make the best of it.
txt_cn: 要接受生活本来的样子，而后尽力而为。
author: Yann Martel

txt_en: Never, never, never give up.
txt_cn: 不，绝不，永不放弃。
author: Winston Churchill

txt_en: We must act out passion before we can feel it.
txt_cn: 要感受热情，须先表达热情。
author: 让-保罗·萨特

txt_en: Love one another, but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
txt_cn: 相爱吧！但别让爱成为羁绊，爱应当是两个灵魂间涌动的海洋。
author: Kahlil Gibran

txt_en: The horizon of life is broadened chiefly by means of the enlargement of heart.
txt_cn: 扩展生活的视野，主要靠开阔心胸。
author: Hugh Black

txt_en: Nothing behind me, everything ahead of me, as is ever so on the road.
txt_cn: 抛开顾虑，探索未知，永远在路上。
author: Jack Kerouac

txt_en: To exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.
txt_cn: 生存就意味着去改变，改变就意味着成熟，而成熟就意味着孜孜不倦地创造自我。
author: Henri Bergson

txt_en: If you wish to reach the highest, begin at the lowest.
txt_cn: 若想到达最高处，先从最低处做起。
author: Publilius Syrus

txt_en: Love and a cough cannot be hid.
txt_cn: 爱与咳嗽均无法掩藏。
author: George Herbert

txt_en: Tomorrow belongs to those who can hear it coming.
txt_cn: 明天属于那些能听见它来临的人。
author: David Bowie

txt_en: Changes and progress very rarely are gifts from above. They come out of struggles from below.
txt_cn: 鲜有改变和进步是上天赐予的，它们来自于自己的苦心奋斗。
author: 诺姆·乔姆斯基

txt_en: Never give up. Expect only the best from life and take action to get it.
txt_cn: 永远不要言弃。要永远只期待最好的事物，并为之付出行动。
author: Catherine Pulsifer

txt_en: A book should serve as the ax for the frozen sea within us.
txt_cn: 书籍是一把利斧，凿开我们内心冰封的海洋。
author: Franz Kafka
